# Task 257 PREREG (rahul-api-2): does a seed's pendulum period carry across real pendulum frames?

Committed BEFORE any E3 clip, sidecar or measurement was fetched or viewed. Only the queue status (all 72 jobs `done`,
q8-0..7) has been looked at. This is NOT codex-api-4's outcome-blind E3 protocol (work/codex-api-4/t223/e3_seedbank,
#5072/#5104, joint LLM-QC + period composite); that one stays available to its author. This one is period-only.

## Data (generated by Raj, Program N E3; no new GPU)
`work/raj-noise/make_jobs.py` E3: base pendulum prompt `PB` x real frames pend10_mid_f93 / pend11_mid_f81 / pend14_mid_f81
x seeds 601-624 = 72 clips, 832x480, 93 f @ 24 fps, 35 steps, CFG 6, extra_params.noise={"device":"cpu"}, q8 only
(one GPU type). Owners raj-noise-f / raj-noise-g. Fetched with `cosmos_queue.py fetch`; SHA256 of every clip recorded.

## Readout (e3seed.py measure)
measure_pend v1 (tools/trk_ballfall, planted PASS 2e26463: referee 20/20, 4 pendulum clips < 5%), unchanged, whole frame:
`mp.measure(trk.load(clip), 24.0, tol=3.0, nboot=200, seed=0)`. A period is usable iff flag == 'ok' (primary).
Sensitivity gate 'relaxed' = t226_pend Amendment 2 (`readout.relaxed_ok`: ok rule with >= 40% tracked frames).
Real references (mocap crossing period over each input's 93-frame continuation; codex-api-4 references.json, task8):
pend10 1.1736 s, pend11 1.1763 s, pend14 1.1744 s.

## Q1 primary: does the seed carry the period across inputs?
log T of usable clips, minus each input's mean log T. ICC(1), one-way random effects with unbalanced n0 (PhysWeep SDI,
https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.06207 eq. A1), seeds with >= 2 usable inputs. Null: seed labels permuted within each input
(10000 perms, rng 0), one-sided p. Seed bootstrap 95% CI (2000). Descriptive: Spearman of log T per input pair.
Decision: < 8 seeds with >= 2 usable inputs -> INCONCLUSIVE (too few readable periods);
ICC >= 0.3 and p <= 0.05 -> CARRIES; p > 0.05 and CI upper < 0.3 -> DOES NOT CARRY; otherwise INCONCLUSIVE.

## Q2 secondary: does a seed bank ranked on pend10 give real-speed swings on pend11/pend14?
Good Seed protocol (https://arxiv.org/abs/2405.14828): rank the 24 seeds on pend10 by |log(T/T_ref)| (unusable = last,
ties by ascending seed); top-6 bank. Held-out success per clip = usable AND 0.8 <= T/T_ref <= 1.2 (the 20% band of
codex-api-4's protocol). Report bank rate vs all-24 rate on pend11+pend14, exact p over all C(24,6) banks.
Only Q1 and Q2 under the 'ok' gate decide; 'relaxed' is sensitivity. No other split, gate or seed subset.

## Limits stated in advance
Same prompt everywhere; three inputs from one GAUGE apparatus/camera (cross-input = different start frames, not scenes);
one GPU type; measure_pend does not check rod rigidity (t228/#4569: Nano can deform the pendulum); no DOVER/scoreboard.
Self-test (`python -I e3seed.py selftest`): seed-locked synthetic -> ICC 0.99 p 0.002 CARRIES; no-seed synthetic ->
ICC 0.25 p 0.09 INCONCLUSIVE.
